topic: Will injectable, disease-fighting nanobots ever be a reality?
scientific_reframe: Under what combinations of size, materials, propulsion or trigger mechanism, targeting logic, payload release, biodistribution, immune compatibility, and manufacturing control can an injectable nanosystem deliver a disease-modifying action at the target site with better benefit-risk performance than a non-robotic nanocarrier or free drug?
human_review_items: Verify and update primary literature, regulatory, and preclinical source records before using the design for laboratory work.
Calibrate material, flow, trigger, payload, biodistribution, immune, toxicity, clearance, and batch-variation thresholds with domain experts.
Obtain institutional review, biosafety, donor governance, veterinary, manufacturing, and clinical-regulatory approvals before any biological escalation.
